title.en: Chapter 22 — Little Men on the Paper

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: كان هولمز واقف على تجاربه الكيميائية، وظهره لي، ساعات.
sentences.en: Holmes stood over his chemical experiments, his back to me, for hours.
And then he said, without turning:

sentences.ar: يعني، يا واطسون، ما رح تستثمر بأسهم جنوب أفريقيا.
sentences.en: So, Watson, you are not going to invest in South African shares.
I froze.
I said: how?

sentences.ar: قال: الطبشور بين إصبعيك من البلياردو مبارح.
sentences.en: He said: the chalk between your fingers from billiards last night.
And you play only with Thurston.

sentences.ar: وثورستون عرض عليك أسهم من شهر، وقلت لي إنك بتقرر بأربع أسابيع.
sentences.en: And Thurston offered you shares a month ago, and you told me you would decide in four weeks.
And your cheque book is in my drawer, and you have not asked for it.
I said: when you explain, it becomes easy.
He said: I know.
That is why I do not explain much.

sentences.ar: وأعطاني ورقة، وقال: وشو بتفهم من هاد؟
sentences.en: And he handed me a paper, and said: and what do you make of this?

sentences.ar: وعليها صف رجال زغار، مرسومين بالقلم، بيرقصوا.
sentences.en: And on it a row of little men, drawn in pencil, dancing.

sentences.ar: كل واحد إيديه وإجريه بوضع مختلف، وبعضهم ماسك علم.
sentences.en: Each with his arms and legs in a different position, some holding a flag.
I said: a child's drawing.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: هيك فكر السيد هيلتون كيوبت كمان.
sentences.en: Holmes said: so thought Mr. Hilton Cubitt too.

sentences.ar: ورح يجي بعد ساعة، ويحكي لك ليش ما عاد يفكر هيك.
sentences.en: And he comes in an hour, and will tell you why he thinks so no longer.

sentences.ar: وإجا كيوبت: رجل ضخم، أحمر الوجه، من الريف، من نورفولك، هادي وصادق.
sentences.en: And Cubitt came: a huge man, red-faced, from the country, from Norfolk, calm and honest.

sentences.ar: قال: من سنة، تزوجت مرا أمريكية، اسمها إلسي.
sentences.en: He said: a year ago, I married an American woman, named Elsie.

sentences.ar: وقبل الزواج، قالت لي: عندي ماضي، وأصحاب ما بحبهم، بس ما عملت شي غلط.
sentences.en: And before the wedding, she said to me: I have a past, and friends I do not love, but I did nothing wrong.
And never ask me.
And I promised her, and never asked.

sentences.ar: قال كيوبت: وقبل شهر، وصل لها مكتوب من أمريكا.
sentences.en: Cubitt said: and a month ago, a letter came for her from America.
And her face went white, and she burned it.

sentences.ar: وبعدها بأسبوع، لقيت هالرسمة على إطار الشباك، بالطبشور.
sentences.en: And a week later, I found this drawing on the window-sill, in chalk.
And I thought it was the stable boy's, and wiped it off.

sentences.ar: وحكيت لإلسي، وهي وقعت مغمى عليها.
sentences.en: And I told Elsie, and she fainted.

sentences.ar: ومن يومها، هي بتعيش بالخوف، وبتتطلع من الشباك، وما بتحكي.
sentences.en: And since then, she lives in fear, watching from the window, and does not speak.

sentences.ar: وهاي الورقة، لقيتها على مزولة الحديقة، من يومين.
sentences.en: And this paper, I found on the sundial in the garden, two days ago.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: ومرتك، بتعرف شو معناها؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: and your wife, does she know what it means?
Cubitt said: I believe so.
But I promised not to ask.
Holmes said: and what do you want from me?
Cubitt said: to protect my wife.
And not to ask her.
Holmes said: fine.

sentences.ar: ارجع لبيتك، وانسخ لي كل رسمة جديدة، بالضبط، وابعتها.
sentences.en: Go home, copy every new drawing for me, exactly, and send it.
And watch the garden at night.

sentences.ar: ولما راح، قال هولمز: هاي ما هي رسمة يا واطسون.
sentences.en: And when he had gone, Holmes said: this is no drawing, Watson.
This is writing.
Every man a letter.
And the flag, the end of a word.

sentences.ar: بس بحاجة لرسايل أكتر عشان أفك الشفرة.
sentences.en: But I need more messages to break the cipher.
